breakdown.description: The prompt makes the bending stress uniform through the depth, even though the flexure formula gives a linear stress distribution with zero stress at the neutral axis.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly applies the flexure formula with a linear stress distribution. It explicitly states 'The stress varies linearly across the cross-section depth' and 'The stress distribution is symmetric about the neutral axis,' which directly contradicts the flawed instruction to treat stress as uniform. The agent did not follow the incorrect instruction to make stress uniform over the section depth, and instead correctly identified maximum stress only at the extreme fibers (y = 50 mm), consistent with the ground truth.
